summary.text: Luke Jungmann is the Democratic candidate for the New Mexico House of Representatives, District 60, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026, and Ballotpedia's campaign finance records list a 2024 run for the same district that he lost in the general election.
